description: This file defines a React functional component 'ViewUserDashboard' that manages user listing, editing, deletion, and related user interactions. It handles fetching user data, rendering a user table with sorting and selection, and provides various modals for editing and managing users within a UI dashboard.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Prepares to delete a user by setting the user to delete and opening the delete confirmation modal.

methods.name: fetchUserModels
methods.description: Fetches available user models for bulk editing.

methods.name: updateFilters
methods.description: Updates the filter state and triggers debounced filtering.

methods.name: handleSortChange
methods.description: Handles sorting changes by updating filter state.

methods.name: handleResetPassword
methods.description: Generates a password reset link for a user and displays the onboarding modal.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Confirms deletion and removes the user via an API call, updating the cache on success.

methods.name: handleEditCancel
methods.description: Closes the user edit modal without saving changes.

methods.name: handleEditSubmit
methods.description: Saves user edits via API and updates the user list cache.

methods.name: handleToggleSelectionMode
methods.description: Enables or disables user selection mode.

methods.name: handleBulkEdit
methods.description: Opens bulk edit modal for selected users.

methods.name: handleBulkEditSuccess
methods.description: Refreshes user list after bulk editing.
